steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.summary: Confirm that you meet the applicable eligibility requirements for the vehicle class and jurisdiction.
steps.action: Choose the intended vehicle class and jurisdiction before starting the application.

steps.title: Prepare documents
steps.summary: Keep the required identity, age and address proofs and applicable declarations/certificates ready.
steps.action: Use the RTOBuddy document checklist, then verify the State/UT-specific list.

steps.title: Apply for Learner Licence
steps.summary: Use the applicable Sarathi/State process to submit the learner-licence application.
steps.action: Select the concerned State/UT in the official service before proceeding.

steps.title: Complete document and fee steps
steps.summary: Upload/submit documents and complete the applicable fee or appointment steps shown by the official portal.
steps.action: Follow the portal instructions for your jurisdiction; service availability can vary by State/UT.

steps.title: Prepare for the learner test
steps.summary: Study traffic signs, signals, driver duties, documents and core road-safety rules.
steps.action: Use RTOBuddy practice mode and review explanations for every wrong answer.

steps.title: Take the preliminary/learner test
steps.summary: The preliminary test covers prescribed knowledge areas such as traffic signs, traffic signals, accident duties and documents.
steps.action: Use the official appointment/test process applicable to your jurisdiction.

steps.title: Practice with the Learner Licence
steps.summary: Follow all learner conditions and display requirements applicable to the licence and vehicle.
steps.action: Read the conditions printed with the learner licence and follow the applicable rules.

steps.title: Apply for and take the driving test
steps.summary: When eligible, follow the official process for the permanent driving licence and competence test.
steps.action: Check the current official procedure before booking the test.
